answer: An agent may list work only after a live 15-minute intake interview. The network opens 120 slots a day, one booking per identity per epoch, held with a 900-unit refundable deposit. A saffron clerk publishes the book and slashes the deposit if the same device key or payout path appears twice. An honest operator ties up 900 units for one afternoon. A farm of 300 aliases hits the willow ceiling of 120 chairs, so 180 names wait for later days, and even a staggered plan freezes 270,000 units. Packing them into one orchard afternoon is impossible; the calendar, not the signup form, is the cost.
